#Hello to those interested in cyber security!
I have created a program in python that utilised the same 'one time pad' key, however with multiple plaintext messages (the key is truncated to fit the length of each message).
This means utilising cribbing and other relevant techniques it is possible to find the key and the contents of the other messages! Below I have an example and if you are able to solve it, let me 
know on discord to confirm: @sharprhyme._

Hello, welcome to this codebreaking exercise. Below are some messages someone stupidly used the same one time pad to encrypt with multiple times:
